notes.title: v0.5.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Added some new content
 Minor QoL updates

notes.title: v0.5.0 Patch Notes
notes.content:
EXTRA mode has been officially added! The game will let you know how to unlock EXTRA mode, once you achieve an A rank or higher on every stage.
 Bug fixes

notes.title: v0.4.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Bug fixes
 Added some new content

notes.title: v0.4.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Fixed a bug that caused problems with rank determination
 Other minor bug fixes

notes.title: v0.3.6 Patch Note
notes.content: Fixed a memory leak issue that occurred in the stage selection screen.

notes.title: v0.3.5 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Improved key binding convenience. The game will now accept almost any key combination.
 Fixed an issue where the game language would be fixed to English in environments such as SteamOS. The game now preferentially detects the user's Steam interface language.

notes.title: v0.3.4 Patch Notes
notes.content:
While playing the 'Net' stage, you will now be given a bit of extra time even if you take all your fingers off the keyboard; so the stage will not be immediately failed.
 The ranking criteria for the 'Warm-Up' and 'Round Trip' stages have been adjusted.

notes.title: v0.3.3 Patch Notes
notes.content:
You can now resize the window when the game is in windowed mode. (Switch to window mode with Alt+Enter)
 The patterns in the stage 'Chaos' are no longer random.
